title: The People Confess Their Sins

questions.question: On which day did the people assemble with fasting?
options: The twenty-fourth day of this month
questions.correctAnswer: The twenty-fourth day of this month
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:1 (ESV): "Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the people of Israel were assembled with fasting..."

questions.question: What did the Israelites separate themselves from?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:2 (ESV): "And the Israelites separated themselves from all foreigners..."

questions.question: What did they do for a quarter of the day?
options: Read from the Book of the Law
questions.correctAnswer: Read from the Book of the Law
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:3 (ESV): "...they stood and read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day..."

questions.question: What does the prayer say God is?
options: You are the LORD, you alone
questions.correctAnswer: You are the LORD, you alone
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:6 (ESV): "You are the LORD, you alone. You have made heaven..."

questions.question: Who did God choose to bring out of Ur of the Chaldeans?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:7 (ESV): "You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans..."

questions.question: What name did God give Abram?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:7 (ESV): "...and gave him the name Abraham."

questions.question: How did God lead them by day and night?
options: By a pillar of cloud and a pillar of fire
questions.correctAnswer: By a pillar of cloud and a pillar of fire
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:12 (ESV): "By a pillar of cloud you led them in the day, and by a pillar of fire in the night..."

questions.question: What did God give them from heaven for their hunger?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:15 (ESV): "You gave them bread from heaven for their hunger..."

questions.question: What idol did they make for themselves?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:18 (ESV): "Even when they had made for themselves a golden calf..."

questions.question: Did God forsake them in the wilderness?
options: No, in your great mercies you did not forsake them
questions.correctAnswer: No, in your great mercies you did not forsake them
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:19 (ESV): "...you in your great mercies did not forsake them in the wilderness."

questions.question: Forty years you sustained them in the wilderness, and they lacked nothing. What happened to their clothes and feet?
options: Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell
questions.correctAnswer: Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:21 (ESV): "...Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell."

questions.question: What did they do to the prophets who warned them?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:26 (ESV): "...and they killed your prophets who had warned them..."

questions.question: How are the Levites described in their interaction with the people in this chapter?
options: They cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God
questions.correctAnswer: They cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:4 (ESV): "...and cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God."

questions.question: What specific attribute of God is highlighted in verse 17?
options: A God ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love
questions.correctAnswer: A God ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:17 (ESV): "But you are a God ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love..."

questions.question: Who are the "kings" mentioned that dominate them now?
options: Kings whom you have set over us because of our sins
questions.correctAnswer: Kings whom you have set over us because of our sins
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 9:37 (ESV): "...the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins..."

key_verse_text: You are the LORD, you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them; and you preserve all of them; and the host of heaven worships you.
